questions.prompt: On a composite index `ON events (org_id, created_at)`, which query cleanly utilizes the leftmost index order?
questions.explanation: B-Tree composite indexes sort primarily by the leftmost key (`org_id`), requiring it to match efficiently.

questions.sectionTitle: Module 3: Indexing, Transactions & Performance Tuning Checkpoint
questions.prompt: Why does `WHERE LOWER(email) = 'alice@x.com'` skip a normal `INDEX(email)` unless configured specially?

options.text: Wrapping an indexed column in a function breaks sargability because the B-Tree stores raw original values, not lowercased hashes
Emails cannot be indexed in B-Trees

questions.explanation: Maintain canonical lowercase emails on write or create a matching expression index `ON users(LOWER(email))`.

questions.sectionTitle: Module 3: Indexing, Transactions & Performance Tuning Checkpoint
questions.prompt: Why use `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` on active production PostgreSQL tables?

options.text: Builds the index cleanly without acquiring write-blocking locks over live INSERT/UPDATE transactions
Skips B-Tree balancing to build instantaneously

questions.explanation: Standard index builds lock writes on busy tables for minutes/hours; concurrent creation avoids downtime.
questions.topic: B-Tree Indexes, EXPLAIN Query Plans & Avoiding Scans

questions.sectionTitle: Module 3: Indexing, Transactions & Performance Tuning Checkpoint
questions.prompt: Why does checking `if (wallet.balance >= amount)` in Node.js memory followed by a separate `UPDATE wallets SET balance = balance - amount` risk negative balances?

options.text: Concurrent requests can both read the old positive balance before either commits (TOCTOU race condition)
Node numbers turn negative on JSON parse
JavaScript floats round numbers down automatically

questions.explanation: Atomic database-level `WHERE balance >= amount` or `SELECT FOR UPDATE` closes race windows cleanly.

questions.prompt: What ACID guarantee ensures that if step 2 (audit log insert) fails mid-transaction, step 1 (balance deduction) is completely undone?
questions.explanation: Atomicity makes every multi-statement transaction strictly all-or-nothing.

questions.prompt: How does the Expand-Contract migration pattern rename a live column with zero deployment downtime?

options.text: Add new column + dual-write/backfill -> update deployed code reads -> drop old column once old pods terminate
Run RENAME COLUMN immediately during peak hours
Truncate the table before running ALTER TABLE
Restart Postgres ignoring running web queries

questions.explanation: Overlap-tolerant transitions prevent rolling pods from crashing on missing column errors.
